newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends firmer.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends firmer.

text.p: White sugar futures picked up from early lows to end a subdued Thursday somewhat firmer as trade buying supported nearby values.

By the close December stood $1.00 firmer at $323.00 and March was up by $1.40 at $320.50. Total volume was 1,858 lots, dominated by the two front contracts. December held above a $321.00 low notched up during Wednesday's session but technical analysts said the price outlook was bearish if support at $320.00 came under new pressure.
